correctness.rationale: The published equation (23) gives positive exponential two-sided inverse-derivative bounds with geometric exponent 2π/|κ|; Lemma 5.4 verifies uniform contraction and C6, yielding finite-word distortion independently of length. For the conformal cylinder probability, chain rule and distortion imply uniform quasi-Bernoulli estimates. Shift-Cesàro averages, uniformly bounded by this conformal probability, identify the unique equivalent stationary law and prove uniform cylinder-ratio bounds. This yields a positive uniform conditional hazard ∼exp[-(2π s/|κ|)k], not merely a one-step marginal. Iterating the hazard proves both-sided avoidance bounds; geometric tail sums prove waiting-time and sharp moment claims; dyadic Borel–Cantelli proves the a.s. record constant. All steps apply with a fixed source-compliant section; no numerical or finite approximation is used to infer infinity.
